title: Specular differentiation in one dimension: a quasi-mean value theorem, regularity, and discontinuities
summary: We develop a theory of specular differentiation on real intervals. The specular derivative is defined by averaging the angles associated with the forward and backward difference quotients and extends classical differentiation. For specularly differentiable and continuous functions, we establish a quasi-mean value theorem and use it to show that continuity of the specular derivative implies $C^1$-regularity.
